name: EPIC 204366401
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 12.5 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,983 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 0.91 solar masses and 12.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,351 K at its surface.
